messages:
Marta: Heads up 1: partial FRA hold on an H100 pallet (PO RWI-2026-07). Need fast decision: RMA hold clearance vs air-replace + loaners.
Liam: What triggered the hold? missing HS or documentation?
Elena (VertexLogistics): Customs flagged 4/12 units for missing end-use documentation and an HS reclass check. Options: 1) submit docs (48-72h), or 2) air-expedite replacements from DE pool (~48h) with brokerage + handler fees.
Jordan: Quick numbers for option 2?
Elena (VertexLogistics): Expedited AWB per 4-unit shipment ~EUR 9k (priority handler + brokerage). Alternatively split: air 2 units + docs clearance 2 units.
Marta: Cluster impact: losing those 4 H100s drops EU H100 capacity ~40% on inference pool. ops-bot: CAPACITY ALERT -> eu-inference-pool degraded 38%.
ops-bot: Suggestion: route latency-tolerant lanes to us-east; flag high-priority lanes degraded.
Liam: Redirecting adds ~30-60ms to EU customers. Can vendor provide temporary loaners from NL depot?
Elena (VertexLogistics): NL loaner pool available but under contract; we can loan 2 units for 14 days for ~EUR 3.2k (includes pickup/return). Serial capture required.
Ken (Customs): For faster clearance submit: end-use cert, proforma with HS 8542.31.90, vendor VAT reg. If uploaded before EOD we can attempt fast-track release.
Pat: Drafting proforma now. PROFORMA excerpt:
PO: RWI-2026-07
Items: 4x H100-48GB (warranty replacements)
HS: 8542.31.90
Value: EUR 0 / note vendor declared replacement value
Vendor VAT: NL123456789B01

Jordan: Marta 1: if we go mixed plan (2 loaners + air 2), what's total delta?
Liam: Mixed plan cost = EUR 9k (air for 2) pro-rated ~4.5k + EUR 3.2k loaner = ~EUR 7.7k plus return shipping and brokerage.
Marta: Approve up to EUR 13k contingency to avoid SLA impacts. Proceed with mixed approach: loaners (2) + expedite 2 replacements.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Actioning: 1) initiate loaner paperwork for 2 units (pickup NL), 2) book express AWB for 2 replacements, 3) submit proforma for 2 units to customs. ETA: loaners 24-36h, AWB 48h ex-customs.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Need serials for RMA tags + LOA. Paste manifest serials please.
Jordan: serials from staging manifest:
- SERN-FF12-001
- SERN-FF12-002
- SERN-FF12-003
- SERN-FF12-004

Marta: Add internal return tag RMA-RWI-07-2026 on paperwork.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Copy. Generating return labels for doc-cleared units + LOAs for loaners. AWB placeholders: AWB-DE-700122, AWB-DE-700123.
Ken (Customs): Include phrasing: "temporary replacement - return within 30 days" on proforma to expedite brokerage handling.
Pat: Uploaded proforma and emailed customs (Ref: CUS-2026-154). Link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/doc/PROF-RWI-2026-07
ops-bot: ROUTING UPDATE: <v2-large-eu> now falls back to us-east until further notice.
Liam: Ops team please add a feature-flag so internal QA doesn't hit degraded nodes.
Marta: Procurement to reconcile extra costs as PO amendment. Pat, create amendment and signature sheet.
Pat: On it. Drafting PO amendment with line for expedited freight + loaner fee.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Note from vendor: returns require DOA photo evidence for warranty RMA acceptance. Please instruct depot to capture inbound photos and scan serials.
Jordan: We'll add photo checklist to inbound SOP and attach to RMA-RWI-07-2026.
Marta: If loaners miss SLA, Plan C: spin 3x g5x in eu-west for training lanes (~EUR 700/day) to avoid customer latency spikes. Keep that as fallback.
Liam: Monitoring ops-bot metrics; will post updates.
Elena (VertexLogistics): Finalizing AWB & LOA, will post cost breakdown and ETA by EOD CET.
Marta: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
